description: The headless gauge core of the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5. A gauge is a display control, so createGauge is a light core: value, range and bands in, computed arc and needle geometry out, plus rootProps with role meter and aria-valuenow. One core drives the styled radial SvGauge and a custom linear meter drawn in SVG from the same geometry, both bound to a single value.

faq.question: What geometry does the core compute?
faq.answer: The normalized fraction of the value within min and max, the arc angles for the sweep, the angle of the needle and the start and end of each band, so a render draws paths without redoing the math.

faq.question: How can a linear meter use radial geometry?
faq.answer: It uses the fraction and the band boundaries and ignores the angles, mapping them to x positions on a bar.

faq.question: What does rootProps add?
faq.answer: role meter with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuenow, plus an accessible label, so the value is announced regardless of how it is drawn.
